description:
There is a time for action and a time for non-action. Movement and stillness. Absorption and reflection. Hopefully we achieve this equilibrium in our own way, at our own pace, in our own respective lives. This record is a navigation through the times we live in. Waking Hours is a call to question systems, routines and actions that have been normalized in our society. It is a call to question our own actions, our own routines and the way we spend our time. Please find a collection of lyrical reminders and mantras within, intended for repetitive use in the years and decades to come. ⁣

I hope this record urges you to ask your own questions. I hope it resonates, I hope it inspires and I hope it brings you warmth in the coldest times. ⠀⠀⠀⠀
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⁣
Sincerely,⁣
Evan Shornstein ⁣
